title: Contours drawn on top of the Cooper marl in the Ladson quadrangle, South Carolina
citation: Colquhoun, D.J., 1961, Contours drawn on top of the Cooper marl in the Ladson quadrangle, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Map Series MS-4, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR page (map sheet). The text panels (Purpose and Scope, Use of Map, Geology, Cooper Marl Surface, References) OCR cleanly and were read. The map face (contour values, power/hand auger hole and seismic station elevations such as '+8'', '+20'', 'A-8') is badly garbled and cannot be tied to holes or locations, so no observations were recorded; a person should read them from the map image. The Cooper Marl age is not stated on the sheet.
